if possible get this game on console rather than steam

cohorts.label: 20-100h

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the PC version is locked to 1080p and 60FPS by default and requires modding or adjustments to run on modern hardware.

citations.review_text:
Every single time I hear the soundtrack I get an itch to play the game again. Sometimes I fall for it.

Needs a little bit of modding for modern hardware, the game's locked to a maximum of 1080p and 60FPS. And unlocking those two still will get some stutters every so often.

Doesn't change anything about this game being an absolute blast to play. Over-the-top, completely ridiculous, fun all around.
Nanomachines, son!

[hr] [/hr]

[h2] METAL GEAR RISING: REVENGEANCE is peak. [/h2]

A true game made for the true masculine people. Wash away the anger and sorrow by slicing open your enemies and extracting their electrolytes. Ruthlessly dismember your enemies just to fight the true villain of the game every few minutes: the camera.

[hr] [/hr]

[h3] Memetic engineering (Story) [/h3]

The story is almost as if it was cooked by Gordon Ramsay and the music by the best musician in the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ world. You will be in sheer shock at how great this game is, the euphoria is just mwah. I love killing my enemies ruthlessly as they scream for help, when I drive my HF Blade through their chest. Looking for a place to relax? KILL YOUR ENEMIES WITH ANGER!

[hr] [/hr]

[h3] Enemies [/h3]

The enemies are kinda dumb, but where the game really shines is with armoured enemies. These put up quite the fight. Spoilers here (skip to the next chapter of this review if you don't want them): THE FIRST BOSS OF THE GAME IS LITERALLY THE TUTORIAL. Bosses are also incredibly hard depending on your difficulty, so learn the mechanics (wait a minute-)

[hr] [/hr]

[h3] Mechanics [/h3]

The PC version of the game is incredibly underworked and janky, since Konami left it to rot. Even while hard to learn and master, I have become a god at parrying. There are also Zandatsu and many other types of attacks created by combinations of light attacks and heavy attacks.

[hr] [/hr]

[h3] Conclusion [/h3]

Depending on the region, I heavily recommend buying this game if you enjoy euphoria and dismembering your enemies, or just a hard game (play on Hard, if that's it). This game has mentally disturbed me into becoming a clinically insane Metal Gear fan and I do not care, join us.

claims.claim: The in-game camera is difficult to manage in tight spaces and during specific challenges like VR missions.

citations.review_text:
Getting 100% of the achievements for this game was quite the ride, I must say. If you like a challenge or want some extra background knowledge to use, which this game is surprisingly full of, give it a try :-)

It was really fun as well, from the excellent controls to the creative fights (sometimes) to the remarkable characters, especially Jetstream Sam, the super cool Brazilian samurai that had his legacy passed on, and Senator Armstrong, very relatable American politician.

While some people call specific stages cruel and inhumane, such as Jetstream Sam's DLC VR Mission 4 and VR Missions 18 and 19, I disagree with these claims, as this is the entire point of them. Not to mention there is no achievement for the Sam level, which is the hardest (took me 3 hours and 30 minutes). Don't get me wrong though, VR Mission 27 is indeed very evil and poorly designed, as you can't properly aim your Zandatsus and have to rely on luck in the dark.

Although I have some complaints about the game's camera. It is very annoying how it automatically turns if it gets too close to your character, which often happens in cramped spaces, like in the VR missions. The saving system isn't great either, it is kind of confusing and saves in the middle of a couple boss fights, such as Mistral and Sundowner. That could cost you your S rank if you don't have a backup save.

But in my opinion, those flaws do not take away from the utter enjoyment I had while playing. That being said, I can confirm this game is very much worth your time and money. I'm glad I played as much as I did.

one of my favourite action games, potentially even OUTRIGHT favourite of all time
had this back on the 360, and ended up getting it again to relive the whole game again
fantastic combat, fantastic music, fantastic bosses, though fairly short with only 8 chapters + the 2 DLC chapters, with most of that length being Files 1-4
my only major complaint is that, if you're going for completion, you're going to learn to hate the camera, because there times where it will pull out every single mathematical equation it can just to find the exact right spot to screw you over
if you can fight the camera, however, then you can fight god himself

also this was probably one of the odder ways to start getting into Metal Gear, even if i knew a bit about the series before playing it lmao

My first metal gear game it was amazing i love the story telling and cool feature that this game provides like blade mode i haven't seen a game with a feature like that at all. Very well built game i really enjoyed it especial fighting all the bosses as they weren't all the same parry slop and required you to survive some parts and attack and parry on other parts. Also including the blade mode for certain parts of the boss fights is really cool. The quicktime events during cutscenes and more interaction during fights makes it much more fun than any other game ive played. I did have a few problems with the camera on pc but i cant blame it cause this game is not very new and it wasnt a big problem. The soundtracks are amazing and very well fit for the fights. I found fighting Senator Armstrong very fun because how many different attacks he has some requiring blade mode and some making you parry and attack. Very well done with the multi stage fight with Senator Armstrong and honestly a fight that i wont forget as it was probably the most fun ive had in a while. The graphics are very good and awesome for the time it was released i cant believe that a game like this came out 12 years ago and nothing has been replicated close to it. I found this game more fun that the newer games in 2026 and i wish they could make a remastered version of this game or a sequel for MGR:R. I love how you can customize your Raiden and give him upgrades as you progress throughout the story. Also having more content after finishing the game is awesome and i love it i still have to finish those parts and have done the story mode 3 times on one save file i love the game so much and i love how well the bosses are created with diversity and unique feature to each boss. i hope that one day we could get another MGR:R game but just as Titan fall there may be no next game and its very sad to see games with such diversity and awesome combat go to waste. I genuinely found this game fun and love my boy Ge…

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long-term players master the combat despite restricted resolutions, rigid stealth, and missing defensive tools.

claims.claim: Resolution is locked to a maximum of 1920x1080, causing display issues on larger monitors.

citations.review_text:
[h1]A masterpiece that has stood the test of time and hundreds of hours of gameplay.[/h1]

I've gone through this game inside and out, unlocked 100% of the achievements (60 out of 60), spent almost 250 hours here (and I don't plan to stop), and I can say with confidence: Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance is one of the best hack-and-slash games in the history of the gaming industry. Let me explain why.

[b]Pros:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Combat System:[/b] It's great. The "Blade Mode" mechanic (freely cutting enemies into pieces) still feels unique and fresh. Parrying requires perfect timing, but it brings incredible satisfaction when executed successfully.
[*] [b]Bosses and Music:[/b] Words aren't enough. Each boss is a separate work of art with its own philosophy. Jamie Christopherson's soundtrack is pure adrenaline (Especially [i]"It Has to Be This Way"[/i]). The music kicks into full effect precisely at the most epic moment of the battle, giving you goosebumps even after a dozen playthroughs.
[*] [b]Plot and Memes:[/b] Raiden's story is full of pathos, cyberpunk politics, and eternal questions about the nature of war. And, of course, memes about nanomachines and Senator Armstrong are already immortal classics.
[*] [b]Difficulty:[/b] Beating the Revengeance difficulty level, especially the DLCs for Sam and Bladewolf, is a tough but fair challenge for your fingers and nerves (especially if you want to 100% the game). Trust me, I know what I'm talking about!
[/list]

[b]Cons:[/b]
[list]
[*] The camera sometimes has a mind of its own, which can be annoying. The graphics and level design are understandably a bit outdated (the game is 13 years old, after all), but the excellent art style and smooth animations fully compensate for this.
[/list]

[b]Bottom line:[/b] If you like fast-paced action games, cool music, and hardcore challenges, this game is a must-buy. 9 sliced Metal Gears out of 10. Have a great day!

Great game, replayed it multiple times
Only issues are graphics related, and how difficult it is to stealth
Resolution is locked to a max of 1920x1080, meaning if you have a monitor larger (2560/3440x1440) like I now have then the game just won't function normally
On the "stealth" side, you're detected if an enemy spots just about anything, a rolling barrel, a moving box, and if they don't then they investigate you and never go away.
Some other small things, there's no direct "dodge" mechanic, instead it's running, heavy to block if you point towards an attacking enemy and the unlockable "dodge slash" skill which doesn't achieve much because it circles around the target, can't exactly backstep with it

This game is still such a banger! You're playing as Raiden, a cyborg fighting with a Katana, being able to slice through anything you encounter. The gameplay is neat, the bossfights are neat, the story is neat but best of all is the music. Bangers like "Rules of Nature", "Collective Consciousness", "A Soul Can't Be Cut", etc. ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ slap! Imagine it like this: After completing the tutorial, in the first mission you will find yourself fighting against a three story tall Scorpion with the tail of a manta ray and the head of a praying mantis made out of metal which breathes fire and throws bombs at you while you only have your Katana and heal off of the organs of other cyborgs you kill on the go and in the background the best melody you ever heard is playing, giving you the most juicy eargasm you ever experienced in your entire life.
HELL YEAH!!! 🔥 🔥 🔥 
This is why I oversee the little flaws in this game when reviewing it like towards the end when they reused some of the bosses or at certain places in the game your main opponent being a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ wall because of 3rd person mode.
All in all when this sounds like fun to you, you should definitely play this game, you won't regret it!
Gameplay: 10/10
Graphic: 7/10
Music: 11/10
Final: 10/10

Finally, here are my impressions of 100%ing this game:

Time Intensity: 8/10 (at least 80h)
Fun: 5/10 (Achievements like Amateur Radio Operator stink)
Hardest Achievement: 8/10 (You're Hired)
Final: 7/10 (Some Achievements suck, but grinding the bosses until I could beat them no hit was hella fun)
It’s a great game, but if you’re going for 100% achievements, prepare to face true hell.
